meta.description: Mental math, solo or with up to twelve players: battle royale, speed race and progress stats.

home.title: Who’s the <hl>fastest</hl> at mental math?
home.lede: Mental math, alone or with up to twelve players online.
home.hint: Type your answer, then press Enter.
home.playOnlineSub: Create a lobby or join your friends with a code.

battle-royale.name: Battle royale
battle-royale.long: Everyone gets the same calculation. A wrong answer or running out of time eliminates you. Time gets shorter every round. The last one standing wins; if every survivor misses the same round, nobody is out.
battle-royale.solo: Chain correct answers for as long as you can. Time gets shorter every round.

speed-race.name: Speed race
speed-race.long: For each calculation, the first correct answer scores the point. One answer per calculation: if you’re wrong, the round goes to the others. On a tie, the fastest overall wins.
speed-race.solo: A series of calculations, one point per correct answer. Your average time tracks your progress.

modesPage.title: Game modes
modesPage.intro: Every game combines a mode, a difficulty level and the operations picked by the lobby’s host.
modesPage.turnTitle: All at once or taking turns
modesPage.turnText: All at once: everyone sees the same calculation at the same time. Taking turns: one player answers while the others watch the answer being typed live. Only battle royale eliminates players.

solo.title: Play solo
solo.intro: Pick your challenge. Your settings are kept for next time.
solo.loginToSave: Log in to keep your stats.
solo.saveError: The game couldn’t be saved. Check your connection.

online.title: Play online
online.intro: Up to 12 players per lobby. Share the code; the host sets the rules and starts the game.
online.createText: You set the rules and get a code to share.
